fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that unidentified persons allegedly damaged a water tank of the complainant near Ponni Nagar College Road at night. The matter was brought to Tiruppur South PS on 2025-10-22, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-22 at about 22:55. The online submission was made by Dharani Shankar (9000000003). No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Murugan Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000309, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00052, as the mobile number 9000000309 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, suspect, college road, mobile number, night, photograph
